treatment_suggestions.title: Paracetamol (Alvedon) for fever
treatment_suggestions.rationale: The child has a fever of 40°C. Paracetamol is the standard treatment for fever in children. The 250 mg dissolving tablet is appropriate for a 20 kg child (10-15 mg/kg = 200-300 mg).

treatment_suggestions.title: Continuous monitoring during transport
treatment_suggestions.rationale: The child had a seizure and is still febrile. Continuous monitoring of vital signs (temperature, pulse, saturation) is important to detect any changes during transport.

treatment_suggestions.title: Transport to pediatric emergency department
treatment_suggestions.rationale: The child had a febrile seizure and requires evaluation to determine the cause of the fever and seizure. Pediatric emergency care is appropriate for a child of this age with a febrile seizure.

drafted_journal:
Situation: Febrile seizure in a 21-month-old child.
Bakgrund: 21-månatig pojke, ingen känd sjukdomshistorik, ingen allergier. Född 2021.
Socialt: Bor med familj.
Aktuellt: Vid vår ankomst vaken. A enligt ACVPU. Fritt andning. Saturation 100% utan syrgas. Lungljud ren. Kallsvettig och blek. Blodtryck 120/75. Hjärtfrekvens 86. EKG visar sinusrytm. Smärta NRS 0/10. Åtgärd: Ger 250 mg Alvedon (munsönderfallande tablett) mot feber. 
Prehospitalt bedömt tillstånd: Febril kramp, oklar genes.
Rekommendation: Till Barnakuten på Huddinge för vidare utredning och vård. Prio 1.
Under transport: Kontinuerlig övervakning av vitaler, feberbehandling med Alvedon.
